cards.card_text: Day after day, the letter says, Jehoram himself will suffer from a severe illness, a disease of his bowels, until it causes his bowels to come out.
cards.verse_text: And day after day you yourself will suffer from a severe illness, a disease of your bowels, until it causes your bowels to come out.’”
cards.snippet: …you yourself will suffer from a severe illness, a disease of your bowels, until it causes your bowels to come out.’”

cards.card_text: After all this, Jehoram is afflicted with an incurable disease of the bowels, the very disease Elijah's letter named.
cards.verse_text: After all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.
cards.snippet: …all this, the LORD afflicted Jehoram with an incurable disease of the bowels.

cards.card_text: Who afflicts Jehoram with this incurable disease of the bowels?
